Order 
The present application has been filed by the applicant/complainant under Section 483(3) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 seeking cancellation of the bail granted in favour of Respondents No.2 by this Court, vide order dated 28.04.2025 passed in Cr.A.No.2003 of 2025, in connection with Crime No.154/2024 registered at Police Station Dabra Sahar, District Gwalior for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 354(c), 354(d), 294, 323, 506 of IPC, Sections 3(1)(w)(ii), 3(2)(v), 3(2)(v-a) of the SC/ST Act, Section 25(1) of the Arms Act and Section 67 of the IT Act.

entities.text: Police Station Dabra Sahar, District Gwalior
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
At the outset, learned Public Prosecutor for the State has opposed the maintainability of the petition, relying on Section 14(A) of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989, which restricts the High Court's power to entertain applications/petitions against bail orders in cases under the Act,
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:4609 2 MCRC-36672-2025 as well as on the judgment of the Coordinate Bench in the matter of Dharam Singh Parihar v. State of Madhya Pradesh, Criminal Appeal No.9530/2024, which held that applications/petitions seeking cancellation of bail in similar circumstances are not maintainable before this Court.

entities.text: Dharam Singh Parihar v. State of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Upon perusal of the record and hearing learned counsel for the State, this Court finds that the application under Section 483(3) of BNS, 2023 is barred by the provisions of Section 14(A) of the SC/ST Act inasmuch as the accused are facing trial for offences under the said Act.

The precedent laid down in the matter of Dharam Singh Parihar (supra) squarely applies to the facts of the present case, precluding interference with the bail order passed by the Special Judge (Atrocities), Guna.
There is no material before this Court to demonstrate any extraordinary circumstances or violation of law by the trial court warranting cancellation of bail in the present case.
In view of the foregoing, the petition is not maintainable and is accordingly dismissed.

It is clarified that this order is confined solely to the question of maintainability and shall not be construed as an expression of any opinion on the merits of the case or on the guilt or innocence of the accused, in the event that the matter is challenged before the appropriate forum in appropriate form in accordance with law.

(MILIND RAMESH PHADKE) JUDGE pwn*
